resources.string: Allow notifications
Allow
If you don\'t allow them, the app works just the same. You can change it any time in the system Settings, Apps, Lector Universal, Notifications.
No permission for notifications. The app works just the same, but you won\'t see its notifications.

While you read or listen with the screen off, Lector Universal can notify you of what is going on: the controls of what is playing, the sleep timer, the progress of an export or a recording, and any problem that stops it.
To notify you of new articles from the feeds you choose, Lector Universal needs permission to show notifications.
To notify you of new episodes from the podcasts you choose, Lector Universal needs permission to show notifications.
To show you the progress of podcast downloads and tell you if one fails, Lector Universal needs permission to show notifications.
